label_descriptions.Radical left: Radical / far left — anti-austerity, anti-capitalist, critical of NATO and of the EU's market orientation, strong workers' rights, public ownership, redistribution.
label_descriptions.Progressive federalists: Center-left and green — pro-EU and in favor of deeper integration, welfare state, climate action, progressive social policy, civil liberties, minority rights.
label_descriptions.Liberal-conservative center-right: Mainstream center-right and liberal center — pro-EU, market-oriented, fiscally conservative, socially moderate.
label_descriptions.Sovereigntist right: National-conservative to nationalist right — soft-to-hard Eurosceptic, defends national sovereignty against further EU integration, restrictive on immigration, traditional and religious values.
